name: Planner / Micro-Planner
summary: Carl Hewitt's 1969 MIT procedural-embedding language for theorem proving and robot model manipulation, with pattern-directed invocation and backtracking; the Micro-Planner subset (Sussman, Winograd, Charniak) powered SHRDLU.

level_notes.0: No surviving implementation verified (Micro-Planner ran on MacLisp/PDP-10).
level_notes.2: Secondary literature is mostly in AI histories; none open and verified.

resources.title: PLANNER: A Language for Manipulating Models and Proving Theorems in a Robot (MIT AI Memo 168)
Description and Theoretical Analysis (Using Schemata) of Planner (MIT AI-TR-258, PhD thesis)
